scope: Proposition 8.7 (Uniform temporal modulus) of the manuscript “Mass and covering exponents for fixed-length honeycomb walks” (preprints/Mass-and-covering-exponents-for-fixed-length-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 58011713f8bb7cd5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every τ > 0 and A > 0 there is Cτ,A < ∞ such that, for every H ≥ 2, outside a set of µH-mass at most Cτ,AH−A, every subwalk σ of l steps satisfies diam(σ) ≤ Hτ (1 + l)3/4 .
